metadata.case_name: LIMBU DHARAMARAJ v. ISS ADAMS SECUFORCE LTD AND ANOTHER

source: The Plaintiff therefore sustained injuries to his right ankle, right shoulder and right side of his back.

Spine: They did not find any neurological deficit and no lumbosacral nerve root impingement in the MRI scan．The back pain should be of a minor degree. They found exaggeration or functional overlay on the part of the Plaintiff in his complaint. There was no muscle wasting, sensory loss or diminished reflexes in his lower limbs.
the impairment caused by the back condition is 1 to 2% of whole person
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: right shoulder sprain with soft tissue injury

source: The Plaintiff therefore sustained injuries to his right ankle, right shoulder and right side of his back.
